_doc: Cross-promotion between Spacerunners apps (owner's own apps only). Read by DomDom Pop, Vidalo and Sky Says. Rules: never a full-screen interstitial, never a reward for installing, only where the host app's age rating covers the promoted app (DomDom iOS 4+ never shows the 9+ Squeeze Out!), soft card at most once per softEveryDays after a positive moment, always dismissible, permanent row in the menu. Attribution: App Store campaign token (ct) and Play install referrer (utm_*), no personal data. Set enabled=false to stop everywhere without an app update. iOS hosts stay off until Squeeze Out! is live on the App Store (1.0.1 was still in review on 2026-10-14); then switch vidalo/skysays ios to true.
